    public static void GenTail(int ox, int oy, double width, double ex, double ey, GA act)   // Shapes.Tail
    {
        double w = width * 16.0, exo = ex * 16.0, eyo = ey * 16.0;
        double sx = ox << 4, sy = oy << 4;
        PlotTileTale(sx, sy, sx + exo, sy + eyo, w, (x, y) => { act.Apply(ox, oy, x, y); return true; });

    static bool PlotLineAct(int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, Func<int, int, bool> plot, bool jump)  // Utils.PlotLine
    {
        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) return plot(x0, y0);
        bool flag = Math.Abs(y1 - y0) > Math.Abs(x1 - x0);
        if (flag) { (x0, y0) = (y0, x0); (x1, y1) = (y1, x1); }
        int num = Math.Abs(x1 - x0), num2 = Math.Abs(y1 - y0);
        int num3 = num / 2, num4 = y0;
        int num5 = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1, num6 = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
        for (int i = x0; i != x1; i += num5)
        {
            if (flag) { if (!plot(num4, i)) return false; }
            else if (!plot(i, num4)) return false;
            num3 -= num2;
            if (num3 >= 0) continue;
            num4 += num6;
            if (!jump)
            {
                if (flag) { if (!plot(num4, i)) return false; }
                else if (!plot(i, num4)) return false;
            }
            num3 += num;
        }
        return true;
    }
    static void PlotTileTale(double startX, double startY, double endX, double endY, double width, Func<int, int, bool> plot)  // Utils.PlotTileTale
    {
        double halfWidth = width / 2.0;
        double vx = endX - startX, vy = endY - startY;
        double len = Math.Sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
        double ux = vx / len, uy = vy / len;
        double px = -uy, py = ux;
        int psx = (int)(startX / 16.0), psy = (int)(startY / 16.0);
        int pex = (int)(endX / 16.0), pey = (int)(endY / 16.0);
        int length = 0;
        PlotLineAct(psx, psy, pex, pey, (x, y) => { length++; return true; }, true);
        length--;
        int curLength = 0;
        PlotLineAct(psx, psy, pex, pey, delegate (int x, int y)
        {
            double num = 1.0 - (double)curLength / (double)length;
            curLength++;
            int p2x = (int)((startX - px * halfWidth * num) / 16.0), p2y = (int)((startY - py * halfWidth * num) / 16.0);
            int p3x = (int)((startX + px * halfWidth * num) / 16.0), p3y = (int)((startY + py * halfWidth * num) / 16.0);
            return PlotLineAct(x + p2x - psx, y + p2y - psy, x + p3x - psx, y + p3y - psy, plot, jump: false);
        }, jump: true);
    }
}

// ================= Pass 32 Dungeon 数据类型（DungeonBounds/DRoom/DHall/DDoor/DPlat）=================
// DungeonBounds（DungeonBounds.cs：Left/Right 钳 [10,maxX-10]、Top/Bottom 钳 [10,maxY-10]；
// CalculateHitbox 保证 R>L、B>T；Contains=Rectangle.Contains 半开区间）
sealed class DBnd
{
    public int L = 10, R = 10, T = 10, B = 10;
    public bool Has;
    static int Cx(int v) => Math.Clamp(v, 10, 4200 - 10);
    static int Cy(int v) => Math.Clamp(v, 10, 1200 - 10);
    public void Set(int l, int t, int rr, int b) { L = Cx(l); R = Cx(rr); T = Cy(t); B = Cy(b); Calc(); }
    public void Calc() { if (R <= L) R = L + 1; if (B <= T) B = T + 1; Has = true; }
    public void Upd(int x, int y) { if (x < L) L = Cx(x); if (x > R) R = Cx(x); if (y < T) T = Cy(y); if (y > B) B = Cy(y); Has = true; }
    public void Upd(int minX, int minY, int maxX, int maxY)
    { if (minX < L) L = Cx(minX); if (maxX > R) R = Cx(maxX); if (minY < T) T = Cy(minY); if (maxY > B) B = Cy(maxY); Has = true; }
    public void TopSet(int t) { T = Cy(t); Has = true; }
    public void Inflate(int a) => Set(L - a, T - a, R + a, B + a);
    public bool Contains(int x, int y) => Has && x >= L && x < R && y >= T && y < B;
    public bool ContainsF(int x, int y, int fluff) => fluff == 0 ? Contains(x, y) : (Has && x >= L - fluff && x < R + fluff && y >= T - fluff && y < B + fluff);
}
sealed class DRoom
{
    public int Seed, X, Y;
    public bool Start, Generated;
    public DBnd Inner = new(), Outer = new();
    public double SX, SY;          // StartPosition/EndPosition（LegacyRoom：val3/val2 终点）
    public double EX, EY;          // EndPosition（金箱候选中心）
    public int Strength;
}
sealed class DHall
{
    public int Seed;
    public bool Generated, ForceX, IsEntrance;
    public DBnd Bounds = new();
    public double SX, SY, EX, EY;  // StartPosition/EndPosition
    public double SDX, SDY, EDX, EDY;
}
sealed class DDoor
{
    public int X, Y, Dir;
    public bool Hall, SkipOther, SkipSpace, Clear;
    public int Fluff;
}
sealed class DPlat
{
    public int X, Y;
    public bool Hall;
}

6998	void GrowGemTreeFn(int tx, int ty, int treeTile)
6999	{
7000	    // GrowTreeWithSettings（cs:30546-31004）宝石树分支：帧值不入哈希，只保掷骰序
7001	    // 门禁序：液体→nactive→墙→基座→侧基→高度掷→净空（cs:30551-30585）
7002	    int num = ty;
7003	    while (act[num * W + tx] != 0 && typ[num * W + tx] == 590) num++;   // 树苗 590（本链位无）
7004	    if (liq[(num - 1) * W + tx - 1] != 0 || liq[(num - 1) * W + tx] != 0 || liq[(num - 1) * W + tx + 1] != 0) return;
7005	    int gi = num * W + tx;
7006	    if (act[gi] == 0) return;                                   // nactive（half/slope 此链位恒 0）
7007	    if (!GEM_WALLS.Contains(wal[(num - 1) * W + tx])) return;
7008	    if (!GEM_GROUND.Contains(typ[gi])) return;
7009	    bool sideFit(int dx) => tx + dx >= 0 && tx + dx < W && act[num * W + tx + dx] != 0 && GEM_GROUND.Contains(typ[num * W + tx + dx]);
7010	    if (!sideFit(-1) && !sideFit(1)) return;
7011	    int height = (int)r.Next(7, 13);
7012	    int num4 = height + 4;                                      // TreeTopPaddingNeeded = 4
7013	    if (tx - 2 < 0 || tx + 2 >= W || num - num4 < 0) return;
7014	    for (int ex = tx - 2; ex <= tx + 2; ex++)
7015	        for (int ey = num - num4; ey <= num - 1; ey++)
7016	        {
7017	            int ei = ey * W + ex;
7018	            if (act[ei] == 0) continue;
7019	            if (!EMPTY_ALLOW.Contains(typ[ei])) return;         // EmptyTileCheck ignoreID=20
7020	        }
7021	    void Put(int ax, int ay) { if (ax >= 0 && ax < W && ay >= 0 && ay < H) { typ[ay * W + ax] = (ushort)treeTile; act[ay * W + ax] = 1; } }
7022	    bool flagL = false, flagR = false;
7023	    for (int i = num - height; i < num; i++)
7024	    {
7025	        int num5 = (int)r.Next(3);                              // ★cs:30595 先掷帧变体
7026	        int num6 = (int)r.Next(10);                             // cs:30596 后掷枝型（掷序即哈希语义）
7027	        if (i == num - 1 || i == num - height) num6 = 0;
7028	        while (((num6 == 5 || num6 == 7) && flagL) || ((num6 == 6 || num6 == 7) && flagR)) { num6 = (int)r.Next(10); }
7029	        flagL = false; flagR = false;
7030	        if (num6 == 5 || num6 == 7) flagL = true;
7031	        if (num6 == 6 || num6 == 7) flagR = true;
7032	        Put(tx, i);
7033	        if (num6 == 5 || num6 == 7) { int k = (int)r.Next(3); int f = (int)r.Next(3); Put(tx - 1, i); }   // 左枝 2 骰
7034	        if (num6 == 6 || num6 == 7) { int k = (int)r.Next(3); int f = (int)r.Next(3); Put(tx + 1, i); }   // 右枝 2 骰
7035	    }
7036	    // 基座 tuft（cs:30846-30861）：两侧草族才置位 + 各 1/3 概率抹除（2 骰无条件）
7037	    bool tuftFit(int dx) => tx + dx >= 0 && tx + dx < W && act[num * W + tx + dx] != 0 && TREE_FIT.Contains(typ[num * W + tx + dx]);
7038	    bool tL = tuftFit(-1), tR = tuftFit(1);
7039	    if ((int)r.Next(3) == 0) tL = false;
7040	    if ((int)r.Next(3) == 0) tR = false;
7041	    if (tR) { int k = (int)r.Next(3); Put(tx + 1, num - 1); }
7042	    if (tL) { int k = (int)r.Next(3); Put(tx - 1, num - 1); }
7043	    int baseK = (int)r.Next(3);                                 // ★cs:30906 无条件掷（基座干身帧骰）
7044	    if (tL || tR) Put(tx, num - 1);
7045	    int crownFx = (int)r.Next(13) != 0 ? 22 : 0;                // cs:30961 树冠骰
7046	    int crownK = (int)r.Next(3);
7047	    Put(tx, num - height);
7048	}

7504	    {
7505	        if (x0 == x1 && y0 == y1) return plot(x0, y0);
7506	        bool flag = Math.Abs(y1 - y0) > Math.Abs(x1 - x0);
7507	        if (flag) { (x0, y0) = (y0, x0); (x1, y1) = (y1, x1); }
7508	        int num = Math.Abs(x1 - x0), num2 = Math.Abs(y1 - y0);
7509	        int num3 = num / 2, num4 = y0;
7510	        int num5 = x0 < x1 ? 1 : -1, num6 = y0 < y1 ? 1 : -1;
7511	        for (int i = x0; i != x1; i += num5)
7512	        {
7513	            if (flag) { if (!plot(num4, i)) return false; }
7514	            else if (!plot(i, num4)) return false;
7515	            num3 -= num2;
7516	            if (num3 >= 0) continue;
7517	            num4 += num6;
7518	            if (!jump)
7519	            {
7520	                if (flag) { if (!plot(num4, i)) return false; }
7521	                else if (!plot(i, num4)) return false;
7522	            }
7523	            num3 += num;
7524	        }
7525	        return true;

7527	    static void PlotTileTale(double startX, double startY, double endX, double endY, double width, Func<int, int, bool> plot)  // Utils.PlotTileTale
7528	    {
7529	        double halfWidth = width / 2.0;
7530	        double vx = endX - startX, vy = endY - startY;
7531	        double len = Math.Sqrt(vx * vx + vy * vy);
7532	        double ux = vx / len, uy = vy / len;
7533	        double px = -uy, py = ux;

7535	        int pex = (int)(endX / 16.0), pey = (int)(endY / 16.0);
7536	        int length = 0;
7537	        PlotLineAct(psx, psy, pex, pey, (x, y) => { length++; return true; }, true);
7538	        length--;
7539	        int curLength = 0;
7540	        PlotLineAct(psx, psy, pex, pey, delegate (int x, int y)
7541	        {
7542	            double num = 1.0 - (double)curLength / (double)length;
7543	            curLength++;
7544	            int p2x = (int)((startX - px * halfWidth * num) / 16.0), p2y = (int)((startY - py * halfWidth * num) / 16.0);
7545	            int p3x = (int)((startX + px * halfWidth * num) / 16.0), p3y = (int)((startY + py * halfWidth * num) / 16.0);
7546	            return PlotLineAct(x + p2x - psx, y + p2y - psy, x + p3x - psx, y + p3y - psy, plot, jump: false);
7547	        }, jump: true);

78	function streamHash(rng: RNG): string {
79	  const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { seedArray: Int32Array; inext: number } }).ur;

85	  }
86	  const ix = ur.inext >>> 0;
87	  for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) step(ix >>> (8 * b));
88	  return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');

235	      const take = (len: number): Buffer => { const out = raw.subarray(p, p + len) as Buffer; p += len; return out; };
236	      const act = take(nt), typLE = take(nt * 2), walLE = take(nt * 2), liq = take(nt), liqT = take(nt);
237	      expect([w, h]).toEqual([4200, 1200]);
238	
239	      const st = new TileStore(w, h);
240	      const n = w * h;
241	      const missing = new Set<number>();
242	      for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
243	        const sheet = typLE[i * 2] | (typLE[i * 2 + 1] << 8);
244	        const id = INV_SHEET.get(sheet);
245	        if (id === undefined) { missing.add(sheet); continue; }
246	        st.type[i] = id;
247	        st.flags[i] = act[i];
248	        st.wall[i] = walLE[i * 2] | (walLE[i * 2 + 1] << 8);
249	        st.liquid[i] = liq[i];
250	        st.liquidType[i] = liqT[i] + 1;   // oracle 用原版液型 id（0水/1岩浆/3微光）→ 仓库 +1
251	      }
252	      expect([...missing], '金标含未注册的原版 sheet').toEqual([]);
253	
254	      const rng = new RNG(1);             // 种子任意，内部态随下一行整体覆写
255	      const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { seedArray: Int32Array; inext: number } }).ur;
256	      ur.seedArray.set(seedArray);
257	      ur.inext = inext;
258	      const gs = newGenState(w, h);
259	      gs.worldSurface = golden.worldSurface;
260	      gs.rockLevel = golden.rockLayer;
261	      gs.dungeonSide = golden.dungeonRight ? 1 : -1;
262	
263	      const grids = new Map<string, string>();
264	      const streams = new Map<string, string>();
265	      runShimmerPass(st, rng, gs, (name) => {
266	        grids.set(name, hashGrids(st));
267	        streams.set(name, streamHash(rng));
268	      });
269	      let firstBad = '';
270	      for (const name of ['shimmershell', 'shimmerpillars', 'shimmeropen', 'shimmer']) {
271	        const okG = grids.get(name) === gold.get(name);
272	        const okS = streams.get(name) === goldStream.get(name);
273	        if (!okG && !firstBad) firstBad = name;
274	        console.log(`${name.padEnd(15)} ${grids.get(name)} vs ${gold.get(name)} ${okG ? '✓' : '✗'}  stream ${streams.get(name)} vs ${goldStream.get(name)} ${okS ? '✓' : '✗'}`);
275	      }
276	      expect(firstBad, 'Shimmer pass 首个分歧段（网格）').toBe('');
277	      for (const name of ['shimmershell', 'shimmerpillars', 'shimmeropen', 'shimmer']) {

281	      expect([gs.shimmerX, gs.shimmerY]).toEqual([golden.shimmerX, golden.shimmerY]);

365	/** AddBuriedChest（1456 cs:35920）下落/门禁段 1:1：
366	 *  自 j 向下扫至 k < maxTilesY-10，逐行检查 anyShimmer / 幼虫 231 → 整体失败；
367	 *  首个 SolidTile（半砖/坡面不算，WorldGen.SolidTile）落定。
368	 *  ±2 邻域（InWorld 100 边距）有 Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716}/祭坛 26/蜥蜴祭坛 237 → 失败
369	 *  ——该检查在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（锚=当前行 k，cs:35992-36002），非仅起始行。
370	 *  notNearOtherChests:true 时经 Chest.NearOtherChests（±25×±8 已有箱）拒绝（cs:36253 透传）。
371	 *  样式/战利品解析与 2×2 放置沿用本仓库 rollChestLoot 管线。 */
372	export function placeBuriedChest(
373	  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState, chests: ChestSink,
374	  i: number, j: number, opts: { style?: number; tile?: number; loot?: number | string; flags?: ChestFlags; trySlope?: boolean; notNearOtherChests?: boolean } = {},
375	): boolean {
376	  // 下落到地面（cs:35931 `for k=j; k<maxTilesY-10; k++`）
377	  let gy = j;
378	  let slopeL = -1, slopeR = -1;   // trySlope 压平的坡度（失败时回填，cs:37567-37575）
379	  for (; gy < st.h - 10; gy++) {
380	    const k = st.idx(i, gy);
381	    if (st.liquid[k] > 0 && st.liquidType[k] === 4) return false;              // anyShimmer → 整体失败
382	    if (st.flags[k] && st.type[k] === LARVA) return false;                      // 幼虫 231 → 整体失败
383	    // ★±2 巨石/祭坛拒绝在扫描循环内**逐行**执行（cs:35992-36002，锚=当前行 k：
384	    //   InWorld(n,num6,100) && Boulders{138,484,664,665,711-716} || 26 || 237）。
385	    //   曾在进循环前以起始行 j 只查一次——起始行下方 2 格内的滚石/祭坛全部漏检
386	    for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
387	      for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
388	        const xx = i + dx, yy = gy + dy;
389	        if (xx < 100 || yy < 100 || xx >= st.w - 100 || yy >= st.h - 100) continue;
390	        const kk = st.idx(xx, yy);
391	        if (!st.flags[kk]) continue;
392	        const tt = st.type[kk];
393	        if (BOULDER_TILES.has(tt) || tt === ALTAR || tt === TALTAR) return false;
394	      }
395	    }
396	    if (solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) {
397	      // trySlope 门（cs:35951-35968）：style 17 时 ±30 盒内不得有箱/越界；
398	      // 压平 (i-1,gy)/(i,gy) 的顶坡供放置（失败时回填）
399	      if (opts.trySlope && opts.style === 17) {
400	        for (let l = i - 30; l <= i + 30; l++) {
401	          for (let m = gy - 30; m <= gy + 30; m++) {
402	            if (l < 5 || m < 5 || l >= st.w - 5 || m >= st.h - 5) return false;  // InWorld(l,m,5)
403	            const nk = st.idx(l, m);
404	            if (st.flags[nk] && (st.type[nk] === CHEST || st.type[nk] === CHEST2)) return false;
405	          }
406	        }
407	      }
408	      if (opts.trySlope) {
409	        if (st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] >= 1 && st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] <= 2) {
410	          slopeL = st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)];
411	          st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = 0;
412	        }
413	        if (st.slope[k] >= 1 && st.slope[k] <= 2) {
414	          slopeR = st.slope[k];
415	          st.slope[k] = 0;
416	        }
417	      }
418	      break;
419	    }
420	  }
421	  if (gy >= st.h - 10) return false;
422	  if (!solidTileHB(st, i, gy)) return false;
423	  // trySlope 失败回填（cs:37567-37575：仅压平过的格才恢复）
424	  const restoreSlopes = (): void => {
425	    if (slopeL > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i - 1, gy)] = slopeL;
426	    if (slopeR > -1) st.slope[st.idx(i, gy)] = slopeR;
427	  };
428	
429	  let tile = opts.tile ?? CHEST;
430	  let style = opts.style;
431	  const flags: ChestFlags = { ...(opts.flags ?? {}) };
432	  let mainId = 0;
433	  let mainKey: string | null = null;
434	  if (typeof opts.loot === 'string') {
435	    mainKey = opts.loot;
436	    mainId = vanillaIdOfKey(opts.loot) ?? 0;
437	    if (mainId === 0 && ITEM_BY_KEY[opts.loot] === undefined) mainKey = null; // 无效键丢弃
438	  } else if (opts.loot !== undefined) {
439	    mainId = opts.loot;
440	  }
441	  if (style === undefined) {
442	    if (gy > st.h - 205) {
443	      // 地狱箱:style 4 + 地狱武器序(cs:36158-36171)
444	      style = 4;
445	      flags.hell = true;
446	      if (!mainId) mainId = nextHellItem(gs);
447	    } else {
448	      style = gy >= gs.worldSurface + 25 ? 1 : 0;
449	      if (style === 0) flags.wooden = true;
450	    }
451	  }
452	  // ---- 冰箱门（cs:36107-36130 1:1）：三析取——(tile21&&style11) ||
453	  // (tile467&&style24) || (无主件 && 位置 && 脚下冰系)。★原版显式传 style 11
454	  // 也进本池（HouseBuilder 冰屋正是此路径）——旧实现 style===undefined 单门漏此
455	  const tBelow = st.type[st.idx(i, gy)];

export function runPyramidPass(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState,
  chests: Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>,
): void {
  const accepted: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> = [];
  for (let idx = 0; idx < gs.pyramidSpots.length; idx++) {
    const cand = gs.pyramidSpots[idx];
    const num = cand.x;
    if (num <= 300 || num >= st.w - 300) continue;
    // 地牢侧回避（cs:15450-15452）：dungeonSide>Left 时须 num ≥ dungeonX+0.15w；
    // dungeonSide<Right 时须 num ≤ dungeonX-0.15w（任一不过即拒）。
    // ★dungeonX 此处 = generatingDungeonPositionX（DungeonCrawler.cs:394 最高房中心 X），
    //   非 Reset 期 dungeonLocation（2026-08-12 金字塔 handoff 疑点核实修复）
    const dgX = gs.generatingDungeonPositionX || gs.dungeonLocation;
    const band = st.w * 0.15;
    if (!(gs.dungeonSide > -1 || !(num < dgX + band))) continue;
    if (!(gs.dungeonSide < 1 || !(num > dgX - band))) continue;
    let k = cand.y;
    while (k < st.h && st.inBounds(num, k) && !st.flags[st.idx(num, k)]) k++;
    if (k >= gs.worldSurface) continue;
    if (st.type[st.idx(num, k)] !== SAND) continue;   // cs:15455 沙列门禁
    // 与全部先序候选（PyrX[0..idx-1]）取最小距，须 ≥220（cs:15460-15472）
    let minDist = st.w;
    for (let l = 0; l < idx; l++) minDist = Math.min(minDist, Math.abs(num - gs.pyramidSpots[l].x));
    if (minDist >= 220) {
      k--;
      pyramid(st, rng, gs, chests, num, k, 75, 125, false);
      accepted.push({ x: num, y: k });
    }
  }
}

/** WorldGen.Pyramid（1456 cs:27816-28160）1:1：沙岩砖 151 主体 + 墙 34 +
 *  入口阶梯掏空 → 之字形下行隧道（端点房间：金箱 1 号主件 848/857/934 三选一、
 *  小堆 185×N、四支火把 91、整排瓦罐 28 style25-27）→ 长出口隧道。
 *  RNG 消费顺序逐掷对齐（num2/num3/num5/num8/num11/num12/房间段/出口段）。 */
function pyramid(
  st: TileStore, rng: RNG, gs: GenState,
  chests: Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>,
  i: number, j: number, pyramidMinDepth: number, pyramidMaxDepth: number, noTunnel: boolean,
): boolean {
  const num = SANDSTONE_BRICK;   // 151
  const wall = 34;               // SandstoneBrickUnsafe
  const gi = st.idx(i, j);
  if (st.flags[gi] && (st.type[gi] === num || st.wall[gi] === 151)) return false;
  const active = (x: number, y: number) => st.inBounds(x, y) && st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] !== 0;
  const deact = (x: number, y: number) => { if (st.inBounds(x, y)) st.flags[st.idx(x, y)] = 0; };
  const setBrick = (x: number, y: number) => {
    if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
    const k = st.idx(x, y);
    st.type[k] = num; st.flags[k] = 1; st.half[k] = 0; st.slope[k] = 0;
  };
  const num2 = j - rng.int(0, 6);                       // j - Next(0,7)
  const num3 = rng.int(9, 12);                          // Next(9,13)
  let num4 = 1;
  const num5 = j + rng.int(pyramidMinDepth, pyramidMaxDepth - 1); // Next(75,125)
  // 主体：逐层加宽的实心沙岩砖塔（cs:27859-27868）
  for (let k = num2; k < num5; k++) {
    for (let l = i - num4; l < i + num4 - 1; l++) setBrick(l, k);
    num4++;
  }
  // 封闭区刷墙 34（cs:27870-27888：3×3 全砖）
  for (let m = i - num4 - 5; m <= i + num4 + 5; m++) {
    for (let n = j - 1; n <= num5 + 1; n++) {
      let all = true;
      for (let a = m - 1; a <= m + 1 && all; a++) {
        for (let b = n - 1; b <= n + 1; b++) {
          if (!st.inBounds(a, b) || !st.flags[st.idx(a, b)] || st.type[st.idx(a, b)] !== num) { all = false; break; }
        }
      }
      if (all && st.inBounds(m, n)) st.wall[st.idx(m, n)] = wall;
    }
  }
  let num8 = 1;
  if (rng.int(0, 1) === 0) num8 = -1;                   // Next(2)==0 → -1
  let num9 = i - num3 * num8;
  let num10 = j + num3;
  const num11 = rng.int(5, 7);                          // Next(5,8)
  let flag2 = true;
  let num12 = rng.int(20, 29);                          // Next(20,30)
  // 入口掏空（cs:27903-27924）：自沙面斜向下切阶梯
  while (flag2) {
    flag2 = false;
    let flag3 = false;
    for (let n13 = num10; n13 <= num10 + num11; n13++) {
      const n14 = num9;
      if (active(n14, n13 - 1) && st.type[st.idx(n14, n13 - 1)] === SAND) flag3 = true;
      if (active(n14, n13) && st.type[st.idx(n14, n13)] === num) {
        if (st.inBounds(n14, n13 + 1)) st.wall[st.idx(n14, n13 + 1)] = wall;
        if (st.inBounds(n14 + num8, n13)) st.wall[st.idx(n14 + num8, n13)] = wall;
        deact(n14, n13);
        flag2 = true;
      }
      if (flag3 && st.inBounds(n14, n13)) {
        const k = st.idx(n14, n13);
        st.type[k] = SAND; st.flags[k] = 1; st.half[k] = 0; st.slope[k] = 0;
      }
    }
    num9 -= num8;
  }
  num9 = i - num3 * num8;
  let flag4 = true;
  let flag5 = false;
  flag2 = true;
  // 之字形下行隧道 + 端点房间（cs:27928-28046）
  while (flag2) {
    for (let n15 = num10; n15 <= num10 + num11; n15++) deact(num9, n15);
    num9 += num8;
    num10++;
    num12--;
    if (num10 >= num5 - num11 * 2) num12 = 10;
    if (num12 <= 0) {
      let flag6 = false;
      if (!flag4 && !flag5) {
        if (noTunnel) flag2 = false;
        flag5 = true;
        flag6 = true;
        const num17 = rng.int(7, 12);                   // Next(7,13)
        const num18 = rng.int(23, 27);                  // Next(23,28)
        const num19 = num18;
        const num20 = num9;
        let cur = num18;
        while (cur > 0) {

void Checkpoint(string name)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < typ.Length; i++) {
        hashTyp[i] = (ushort)(act[i] != 0 ? typ[i] : 0);
        hashGho[i] = (ushort)(act[i] == 0 ? typ[i] : 0); // inactive 格残留 type（幽灵 parity）
    }
    checkpoints.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashTyp):x8} {Fnv8(act):x8} {Fnv16(wal):x8} {Fnv8(liq):x8}");
    ghostPts.Add($"{name}|{Fnv16(hashGho):x8}");
}

/** SurfaceWaterInJungle（1456 cs:15887-15909）1:1：逐列自 worldSurfaceLow 扫到
 *  worldSurface-1，首个活性格若是丛林草 60 → 其上两格灌满水（liquidType 0=水）。
 *  原版整 pass 零 RNG——旧实现误作"挖湿隧道"（digTunnel 消耗大量 RNG 且语义完全不符）。 */
export function runWetJunglePass(st: TileStore, _rng: RNG, gs: GenState): void {
  const h = st.h;
  for (let i = 0; i < st.w; i++) {
    for (let j = Math.floor(gs.worldSurfaceLow); j < gs.worldSurface - 1; j++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(i, j)) break;
      const k = st.idx(i, j);
      if (!st.flags[k]) continue;
      if (st.type[k] === JUNGLE_GRASS) {
        // (i, j-1) 与 (i, j-2)：liquid=255、liquidType 0（原版编码 0=水 → 本仓库 1）
        if (st.inBounds(i, j - 1)) {
          const a = st.idx(i, j - 1);
          st.liquid[a] = 255; st.liquidType[a] = 1;
        }
        if (st.inBounds(i, j - 2)) {
          const b = st.idx(i, j - 2);
          st.liquid[b] = 255; st.liquidType[b] = 1;
        }
      }
      break; // 首个活性格即止（原版 break）
    }
  }
  void h;
}

function placeTorch(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, style: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  // 原版 PlaceTile case4（cs:59863）：frameY = 22*style（style 在 Y 轴！）；
  // 此前 style*22 写 X = 轴向反了 → style≥6 全部越界（Tiles_4 宽仅 6 列）
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, TORCH, 0, style * 22);
}

/** PlaceSmallPile（size1=2×1）：fx=pileStyle*36(+18)，fy=18；下方双列实心 + 双格净空 */
function placeSmallPile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, pileStyle: number, pileSize: number): void {
  if (pileSize !== 1) return;
  const solidAt = (xx: number, yy: number) => st.inBounds(xx, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(xx, yy)] !== 0
    && !!TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(xx, yy)]]?.solid;
  if (!solidAt(x, y + 1) || !solidAt(x + 1, y + 1)) return;
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return;
  if (!st.inBounds(x + 1, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]) return;
  st.setTileSilent(x, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 36, 18);
  st.setTileSilent(x + 1, y, SMALL185, pileStyle * 36 + 18, 18);
}

/** PlacePot（1456 cs:54082）：style 由调用方掷；变体 Next(3) 仅在放置成功时消费 */
function placePotRow(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, x: number, y: number, style: number): void {
  for (let dx = 0; dx < 2; dx++) {
    for (let dy = -1; dy <= 0; dy++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(x + dx, y + dy) || st.flags[st.idx(x + dx, y + dy)]) return;
    }

  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;

  st.setTileSilent(x, y, TORCH, 0, style * 22);
}

/** PlaceSmallPile（size1=2×1）：fx=pileStyle*36(+18)，fy=18；下方双列实心 + 双格净空 */
function placeSmallPile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number, pileStyle: number, pileSize: number): void {
  if (pileSize !== 1) return;
  const solidAt = (xx: number, yy: number) => st.inBounds(xx, yy) && st.flags[st.idx(xx, yy)] !== 0
    && !!TILE_DEFS[st.type[st.idx(xx, yy)]]?.solid;
  if (!solidAt(x, y + 1) || !solidAt(x + 1, y + 1)) return;
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x, y)]) return;
  if (!st.inBounds(x + 1, y) || st.flags[st.idx(x + 1, y)]) return;

 "new_string": "/** 导出给 tests/_freeze-caves.test.ts（SW_FREEZE_CAVES=1 冻结基线再生用） */\nexport function chainCheckpoints(seedText: string, evil: 0 | 1) {\n  const { world, rng, gs } = runResetAndTerrain({ width: 4200, height: 1200, seedText, evil });\n  const st = world.store;\n  const out = new Map<string, string>();\n  const outWall = new Map<string, string>();\n  // RNG 流指纹探针（SW_STREAM_PROBE=1 时逐检查点打印；同 oracle StreamHash 算法）\n  const streamProbe = typeof process !== 'undefined' && !!process.env.SW_STREAM_PROBE;\n  const streamHash = (): string => {\n    const ur = (rng as unknown as { ur: { seedArray: Int32Array; inext: number } }).ur;\n    let h = 0x811c9dc5;\n    const step = (b: number) => { h = Math.imul(h ^ (b & 0xff), 16777619) >>> 0; };\n    for (let i = 0; i < ur.seedArray.length; i++) {\n      const v = ur.seedArray[i] | 0;\n      for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) step(v >>> (8 * b));\n    }\n    const ix = ur.inext >>> 0;\n    for (let b = 0; b < 4; b++) step(ix >>> (8 * b));\n    return h.toString(16).padStart(8, '0');\n  };\n  const snap = (name: string) => {\n    out.set(name, hashGrids(st)); outWall.set(name, hashWalls(st));\n    if (streamProbe) console.log(`STREAM ${name}|${streamHash()}`);\n    // 网格导出钩子(对账插桩:dormant——__cavesGridExport 存在时 dump 指定检查点的 typ/act)"
